name: Wanming
source:
The current club president is sometimes referred to as "Mom" by club members. She is really good at taking care of people and loves to worry.
According to her, this kind of personality comes from observing Yumo. Although there is a big difference between the two in their words and deeds, perhaps their natures really have a lot in common?

[Translated from [url=https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/3851]CnGal[/url]]
